goals.0: Find the password hidden in behemoth0's memfrob-obfuscated check, get a shell, read the next password.
goals.1: Overflow behemoth1's gets() buffer and get a shell despite ASLR-off ret2libc + dash's privilege drop.
goals.2: Win the PID-file race in behemoth2: it touch-es ./<pid>, sleeps, then cat-s it as the next user.
goals.3: Exploit behemoth3's printf(buf) format string to hijack puts() into stack shellcode.
goals.4: behemoth4 prints the file /tmp/<its pid> - predict the pid and pre-plant a symlink to the password file.
goals.5: behemoth5 UDP-sends the next password to localhost:1337 - be there to receive it.
goals.6: Feed behemoth6_reader a shellcode.txt (no 0x0b bytes allowed) that prints HelloKitty.
goals.7: behemoth7 checks argv[1] is alpha/space - but only the first 512 chars; its strcpy buffer is 524. Overflow past the checked prefix.
